text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A short while earlier, at the URA<n>awards ceremony...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove has been chosen to be the<n>URA's
Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The title is a prestigious one<n>presented by the URA
to the best<n>performing racer in that year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since Air Groove has helped us on<n>more than one
occasion, we decide to<n>attend the award ceremony
in<n>support.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's hear from the<n>Umamusume of the
Year, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for selecting me for this<n>unexpected
honor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will always endeavor to live up to<n>your
expectations while bearing the<n>honor of being this
generation's<n>representative.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I hope you will lend your support to<n>me and my
wonderful and worthy<n>competitors in the races of
this<n>year's Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove was so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's really no wonder why Air Groove<n>is known as
the Empress. Her<n>speech made me realize anew
just<n>how incredible her presence is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This all reminds me of the time<n>McQueen was
selected as the<n>senior-year Goddess...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She was so stately and dignified...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
McQueen was the literal epitome and<n>embodiment
of a Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And Air Groove is just like her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Their dignity and strength are surely<n>what make
them true representatives<n>of their generations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But Air Groove is more than that to<n>me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's someone who never stops<n>seeking new
challenges and pushing<n>herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even during the Japanese Oaks, she<n>was the ideal
that guided me along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to follow in Air<n>Groove's
footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I walk the path she walked and<n>reach the heights
she reached...<n>Maybe if I become like her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I can forge a new Mejiro<n>legacy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to continue the legacy Ramonu<n>left behind...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just then, I feel a fleeting sense of<n>discomfort
spread through my chest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But before I can even try to figure out<n>what it is,
Mejiro Dober addresses<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you think she'll race in the next<n>Osaka Hai? She
will, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Okay... I'll show Air Groove just how<n>much closer
I've gotten to my ideal at<n>the Osaka Hai, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to hold anything back in<n>that race!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober's motivation is through<n>the roof.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I try to tell myself there's nothing to<n>worry about,
but I'm not quite<n>convinced...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm still falling short. I must<n>push myself
even farther...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright! You're still going?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Good evening, Ryan! Such a pleasant<n>night, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I'm the leisurely sort, so I<n>was taking my
time through each<n>exercise. I didn't even realize
how<n>late it'd gotten until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you take a break? I<n>wanna talk to
you for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp... Ah! That was refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the drink, Ryan. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad I got you something to<n>drink now...
but have you been<n>staying hydrated? Eating
properly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes, of course. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're awfully concerned<n>about me today,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... It's just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
During my classic year, I always fell<n>short in my
races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I just... How do I put this? I was<n>just wondering
if you might be<n>feeling pressured or—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Arima Kinen, I was<n>watching a
feature on TV that<n>spotlighted classic racers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They didn't talk about Dober and me<n>at all...
Instead, they focused on the<n>accomplishments of
you and other<n>great Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure why they didn't mention<n>Dober, but I
thought it made perfect<n>sense that they didn't bring
me up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I placed fourth at the Satsuki Sho and<n>third at the
Japanese Derby and<n>Kikuka Sho. I wasn't even
able to<n>participate in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My results weren't anything to be<n>ashamed of, but
they weren't exactly<n>great accomplishments either.
They<n>were never quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Dober performed<n>splendidly in
the Triple Tiara tour and<n>was even selected to race
in the<n>Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We both vowed that we would walk<n>the difficult
path of forging new<n>legacies for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But Dober is the only one who is<n>actually making
any progress.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, I've decided to run in the spring<n>Tenno Sho
next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the one to grant the<n>Mejiros' wish...
No, not just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to claim that glorious spring<n>plaque with a
performance brilliant<n>enough to exceed every past
Mejiro<n>achievement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's why I have no choice but to<n>push myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm not strong enough to<n>conquer the
3,200-meter run nor the<n>Yodo slope, but I need to be
if I want<n>that plaque.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You know, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I love the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I love our long history, our great<n>accolades, the
expectations that come<n>with our name, and
everyone who is<n>crowned with the same name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's the reason why I want to<n>carry this honor
and forge a new<n>legacy alongside Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh... I had no idea...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I had forgotten what it was<n>like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
After my own disappointing<n>performance in the
Classics, I didn't<n>want anyone to tell me to take it
easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted people to cheer me on! I<n>wanted them to
say that they hoped<n>to see me win the next time I
tried!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So... I'm going to say that to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Win, Bright. I'm expecting a lot from<n>you in your
future!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Ryan! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I'll keep your<n>words forever
carved into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear! I'll get out of your way<n>now! I'm
going to head back first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to win, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will claim a new, glorious victory for<n>the Mejiro
name.
